content:
Alongside the new Mac mini, Apple today unveiled the next generation of Mac Studio. The new Mac Studio lineup features M5 Max and M5 Ultra chips, with support for up to 512GB of unified memory.

The new Mac Studio models are available for pre-order starting today.

M5 Max Mac Studio

First, Apple announced the new Mac Studio with M5 Max, an upgrade over the previous M4 Max model. The M5 Max debuted earlier this year in the MacBook Pro.

The M5 Max features an 18-core CPU, including 6 efficiency cores and 12 performance cores. The GPU can be configured with up to 40 cores, with each core featuring a built-in Neural Accelerator. Apple says GPU performance is up to 50% faster than the previous generation. Unified memory bandwidth reaches up to 614GB/s, an improvement over the 546GB/s found in the M4 Max generation.

The M5 Max Mac Studio starts with 36GB of unified memory and supports up to 128GB. For comparison, that's the same configuration as when the M4 Max Mac Studio first launched. However, over the past year, due to industry-wide memory shortages, Apple has gradually reduced the options. As of yesterday, the M4 Max Mac Studio started at 36GB of memory and topped out at 96GB.

Here are some benchmark figures for the M5 Max Mac Studio shared by Apple:

  • LLM prompt processing in LM Studio is up to 10.7x faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Max, and 3.9x faster than M4 Max.
  • Text-to-image performance is up to 7.4x faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Max, and up to 3.5x faster than M4 Max.
  • Magic Mask performance in Blackmagic Design DaVinci Resolve Studio is up to 5.3x faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Max, and up to 3x faster than M4 Max.
  • DNA sequencing basecalling with Oxford Nanopore MinKNOW is up to 3.5x faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Max, and up to 1.9x faster than M4 Max.

M5 Ultra Mac Studio

The real star of today's announcements is the M5 Ultra Mac Studio.

The new M5 Ultra Mac Studio offers up to a 36-core CPU, including 12 efficiency cores and 24 performance cores. Multi-threaded performance is up to 1.3x faster than the previous-generation M3 Ultra Mac Studio.

The M5 Ultra features up to an 80-core GPU, which Apple calls the most powerful GPU ever in an Apple silicon chip. This chip also brings Neural Accelerators to the Ultra lineup for the first time. Neural Accelerators are dedicated hardware within each GPU core designed to accelerate AI workloads.

For memory, the Mac Studio with M5 Ultra starts at 96GB and can be configured up to 512GB, the same as when the M3 Ultra Mac Studio first launched. However, over the past year, Apple cut the memory options for the M3 Ultra Mac Studio down to just 96GB due to memory shortages. Memory bandwidth reaches up to 1.2TB/s.

The media engine in the M5 Ultra features twice as many video encode/decode blocks as the M5 Max, supporting simultaneous playback of up to 33 streams of 8K ProRes video.

Apple lists the following benchmark figures for the M5 Ultra Mac Studio:

  • CopyCat ML training performance in Foundry Nuke is up to 15.4x faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Ultra, and up to 3.3x faster than M3 Ultra.
  • LLM prompt processing in LM Studio is up to 9.8x faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Ultra, and up to 4x faster than M3 Ultra.
  • Text-to-image performance is up to 8.2x faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Ultra, and up to 4.3x faster than M3 Ultra.
  • Scene rendering performance in Maxon Redshift is up to 4.7x faster than the Mac Studio with M1 Ultra, and up to 1.7x faster than M3 Ultra.

More Mac Studio specs and details

  • Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 support, powered by the Apple N1 networking chip
  • Support for up to eight external displays, or up to four Studio Display XDRs, with 5K resolution and 120Hz refresh rate
  • Storage performance benefits from PCIe Gen 6 support, doubling speeds
  • Thunderbolt 5 bandwidth up to 120Gb/s
  • genlock synchronization via USB-C support for precise coordination of displays with professional camera shoots

Mac Studio pricing and availability details

The Mac Studio with M5 Max starts at $2,499, with a base configuration including 512GB of storage. This pricing matches the M4 Max Mac Studio. The Mac Studio with M5 Ultra starts at $5,499 with 1TB of storage, representing a $200 price increase over the M3 Ultra version.

Buy Mac Studio from Apple:

  • M5 Max Mac Studio: from $2,499 (education: $2,299)
  • M5 Ultra Mac Studio: from $5,499 (education: $5,099)

The new Mac Studio lineup is available for order starting today, with deliveries beginning September 22. However, Apple says the M5 Ultra Mac Studio with 512GB of memory "will be available late October."
